name: Soul Reaper
description: An axe able to sunder body and soul.

description_citations.text: "Rebirth of Karona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl's Soul Reaper kills Akroma, Phage and Zagorka; Akroma dies in peace and Karona is born.
timeline.quote: Akroma finally died in peace, knowing that Ixidor had been avenged at last.

citation.text: "Akroma", section "Rebirth of Karona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl declares war on Ixidor and leads the Cabal and Krosan alliance against Topos in the Nightmare War, defeating his Mirari-possessed persona.
timeline.quote: Kamahl led the joint forces into battle

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Nightmare War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl meditates in Krosa for a year until Stonebrow revives him with the Soul Reaper.
timeline.quote: Green energy flowed from Soul Reaper to Kamahl, who was revitalized

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Nightmare War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl swings the Soul Reaper in Sanctum, killing Phage, Akroma and Zagorka, whose merged souls become Karona.
timeline.quote: the axe claimed Phage and Akroma's lives, as well as an unexpected third life

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Rebirth of Karona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl arrives with Soul Reaper and Zagorka jumps from her tower, crashing onto Phage and Akroma as Soul Reaper falls and kills them all; the goddess Karona is born.
timeline.quote: From the combination of their three souls and bodies, and the magic of Soul Reaper, the goddess Karona is born.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Cabal and Kamahl form a truce and an army, forging the Soul Reaper to kill Akroma.
timeline.quote: create the Soul Reaper, an ax with enough power to kill Akroma.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl charges in on Stonebrow and hurls Soul Reaper to slay both; Zagorka leaps from a tower to stop it.
timeline.quote: hurled herself from a tower, hoping to stop the inevitable

citation.text: "Rebirth of Karona", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Soul Reaper cleaves Akroma, Phage and Zagorka; their simultaneous deaths unleash ancient magic and a blinding explosion.
timeline.quote: The Soul Reaper struck true against Akroma, Phage, and Zagorka, cleaving them all in twain.

citation.text: "Rebirth of Karona", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: An axe Kamahl wields that slays Akroma, Phage and Zagorka.

citation.text: "Akroma". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: An axe made from the Patriarch's old axe and the broken halves of Kamahl's druid staff, symbol of the Cabal-Krosa alliance.

citation.text: "Kamahl". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: The weapon forged to kill Akroma, wielded by Kamahl.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: An ax forged by uniting the Cabal's and Kamahl's weapons with enough power to kill Akroma.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
